keep.quote: Your own chip started from a crowd too. Last year, over 9 lakh people applied for UPSC's civil services exam. And 958 got in (c01). About one in a thousand.
But nearly four in ten of them never even sat the paper (c02).
And yours? Here's the number nobody puts on a coaching poster. Of the people who reached last year's interview room... about one in three got in (c03).
